I have stayed in many establishments, but this was less of a "hospitality experience" and more of a social experiment in how much a guest can endure before losing their mind.
The Arrival & Staff
Upon arrival, the front desk staff treated my presence as a personal insult. I wasn't greeted with a "welcome," but rather a heavy sigh and a blank stare that suggested I was interrupting a very important session of doing absolutely nothing. When I dared to ask about the lack of hot water, the receptionist responded with a level of condescension usually reserved for explaining basic math to a toddler. The sheer arrogance of the team here is the only thing they seem to have in abundance. " My suggestion to everyone avoid this hotel starline residency, such a shameless behaviour by their staff members and receptionist 👎

Manager is very rude 😔
